notes: «[رحمه الله]» is a blessing and «[قال]» a verb: both left out
«سئل جابر» : Jabir is asked and answers («فرفع حاجبيه ... ذاك خير البرية»), so he is the last link; the questioner after «فقيل له» is unnamed and in the scene
